articles.summary: If Q4 was about launching Flex, Q1 has been about scaling with customers and partners. As more energy retailers move from early pilots to operational programs, the focus is shifting. It is less about whether flexibility works, and more about how to run programs reliably across growing portfolios of devices and markets. This quarter reflects that shift.

articles.summary: Indra Renewable Technologies, a UK-based smart energy technology company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Malvern, Worcestershire, is working with Enode to make its chargers available within the energy apps and services that retailers offer to their customers. The company specializes in intelligent EV charging and has been an early driver of bidirectional charging, showing how EVs can support both households and the wider energy system. Through this partnership, Indra chargers can be connected into energy apps and flexibility programs powered by Enode. This allows Indra owners to connect their chargers to their energy provider’s app and access smart charging features without any additional setup.
articles.title: Indra and Enode partner to bring smart EV charging into energy apps and flexibility programs
